description: The drawing is a line diagram titled "Diagram 5 Maximum floor area enclosed by structural walls", with the note "See para 2C14" at the top left. It is split into two parts. Part a, headed "Structural walls on all sides", contains two floor plans drawn as double-line rectangles. The upper plan is a single enclosed rectangle, labelled inside "Area not exceeding 70m²". The lower plan shows two adjoining rectangles of unequal size, each fully enclosed by walls; the larger is labelled "Area not exceeding 70m²" and the smaller is also labelled "Area not exceeding 70m²". Part b, headed "Structural walls on three sides", shows plans drawn as U‑shaped double‑line walls with small tab‑like returns at the open end. The upper plan is a single such enclosure, labelled "Area not exceeding 36m²". The lower plan shows two U‑shaped enclosures side by side; the left one is divided into two areas, each labelled "Area not exceeding 36m²", and the right one is a single area labelled "Area not exceeding 36m²".
